Design Framework

A library of web page designs, layouts and voices, written to be consumed by AI coding agents. Pick the ones you want and name them in your prompt.

Pick a design, a layout and a voice. This generates a DESIGN.md — copy it, or save it, into your project's repo root. Agents look for DESIGN.md by default, so this points them at the right combination without you having to name it in every prompt.

DESIGN.md

Designs

What it looks like — colour, type, spacing, and the styling of every component. Each demo is a kitchen sink: the same components, in the same order, so designs can be compared directly.

design learn A Duolingo-inspired learning interface: dark navy surfaces, green action buttons, rounded forms, and a friendly rhythm built around momentum and progress. DESIGN.md · kitchen sink design material-design Google's Material Design with the classic Material Design 2 blue. Tonal surfaces, elevation with shadow, fully rounded buttons, and Roboto typography. Colorful but systematic. DESIGN.md · kitchen sink design playful Bright, cheerful, energetic. A vibrant purple and orange palette with generous rounded corners that brings joy to every interaction. DESIGN.md · kitchen sink design slate A calm, neutral product UI. Cool greys, one blue accent, restrained depth. The design equivalent of getting out of the way. DESIGN.md · kitchen sink design warm-paper Editorial and reading-first. Warm off-white paper, soft near-black ink, serif for content, sans for UI chrome. One muted oxblood accent. Minimal chrome, generous rhythm, 16px body text. DESIGN.md · kitchen sink

Layouts

Where everything goes — regions, sizes, scroll behaviour, and responsive rules. Each demo is a wireframe: greyscale, with <placeholder> labels marking what belongs where.

layout app-shell Viewport-locked application shell. Fixed sidebar, fixed top bar, one scrolling content pane. LAYOUT.md · wireframe layout document-editor A centred writing surface with a collapsible document tree on the left and a contextual inspector on the right. The document is the interface. LAYOUT.md · wireframe layout social-feed Three-column viewport-locked social media layout. Fixed top nav, fixed sidebars, scrolling center feed with constrained max-width content. LAYOUT.md · wireframe layout split-inbox Three-pane list-detail layout with independent scroll regions. Left folder rail, middle item list, right detail pane. Viewport-locked shell with a navigation-stack transformation on mobile. LAYOUT.md · wireframe

Voices

How it speaks — attributes, mechanics, vocabulary, and the actual strings a product says. Each demo is a string sink: the same writing situations, in the same order, in greyscale, so voices can be compared line for line.

voice plain-spoken Warm but direct. An expert peer explaining something clearly and then stopping. No jargon, no hype, no hedging — and no coldness either. VOICE.md · string sink voice upbeat Warm and encouraging. Notices when something goes well, softens it when something doesn't, and assumes the reader might be new here rather than expert at this. VOICE.md · string sink

Using these

The three axes combine freely. Name the ones you want in your prompt:

Build me a settings page. Use the styling and components from the learn design, the app-shell layout, and the plain-spoken voice.

The agent reads the DESIGN.md, LAYOUT.md and VOICE.md in the named folders, copies the design's theme.css into the project, and fills the layout's regions with the design's components. CLAUDE.md in the repo root has the full agent instructions.

Adding your own

Point an agent at CREATE-DESIGN.md, CREATE-LAYOUT.md or CREATE-VOICE.md along with what you want. All three are written as complete prompts. Run node scripts/check.mjs and node scripts/build-gallery.mjs when you are done.
